name: paper-plugin
description: Codex plugin for academic paper reading, writing, citation, response, and figure workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Academic paper reading, writing, citation, response, and figure workflows
interface.longDescription: A multi-skill Codex plugin for reading papers, drafting manuscripts, finding citations, preparing rebuttals, generating paper-based presentations, building figures, and writing data statements.
defaultPrompt: Turn this paper into a source-grounded bilingual reader with figure anchors.
Draft or restructure this manuscript section and flag missing evidence.
Find supporting references for these claims and export usable citations.
